description: Object type with keys `K` and values `V`. With a literal union for `K`, every key is required.
A `Record<Union, V>` that becomes a compile error as soon as the union gains a member without an entry.
Equivalent to an index signature. Reads are typed `V` even for missing keys unless `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is on.
A record where every key of the union is optional, e.g. group-by results.
